unitTitle: Greet, be polite, spell your name
title: Grammar: Asking questions
subtitle: Unit 2: Greet, be polite, spell your name

steps.title: Asking questions
steps.body: There are three ways to ask a yes/no question. You use the first two. You recognise the third.

steps.title: Yes/no questions
rows: Everyday, easiest. Same words as the statement.

steps.title: Asking questions
steps.body: Question words go at the start (or at the end in casual speech): Où habitez-vous ? Comment vous appelez-vous ? Quel âge avez-vous ? Quand ? Pourquoi ? Combien ? Answer pourquoi with parce que.

steps.title: Tip
steps.body: When you are unsure, add est-ce que and keep the rest of the sentence unchanged: Est-ce que + normal sentence ? It is never wrong.

steps.title: In Canada
steps.body: In Québec you will often hear -tu added at the end of a question: Tu viens-tu ? It is informal Québec speech. Understand it, but in the exam use est-ce que or rising intonation.
